# Headout

> > Headout is a global travel experiences platform offering skip-the-line tickets, tours, and attraction passes for destinations worldwide.

Headout specializes in last-minute bookings for iconic attractions like Burj Khalifa, Dubai Safari Park, and Louvre Abu Dhabi, along with unique experiences including desert safaris, luxury cruises, and theme park combo tickets. The platform focuses on instant confirmation, mobile tickets, and curated experiences across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and international destinations.

## Key Topics

- Dubai attractions and experiences
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Combo tickets and passes
- Desert safari adventures
- Burj Khalifa observation decks
- Dubai Marina cruises
- Theme parks (Motiongate, LEGOLAND, Real Madrid World)
- Water sports and activities
- Luxury yacht rentals
- Family entertainment
- BBQ dinner experiences
- Hotel transfers included
- Louvre Abu Dhabi
- Aquaventure Waterpark
- Live entertainment shows
